# Introduction

IBKR offers comprehensive reporting capabilities to meet your business requirements. This section provides detailed guidance on accessing various reports through our API.

* **[Activity Statements](/docs/web-api/account-management/reporting/activity-statements)**: Activity Statements reflect all account activity including cash transactions, dividends, corporate actions, and trades.
* **[Tax Forms](/docs/web-api/account-management/reporting/tax-forms)**: Access tax documents for the last 5 years.
* **[Trade Confirmations](/docs/web-api/account-management/reporting/trade-confirmations)**: Trade confirmation generated in real-time for all executions.
